title: Figure 1: Forces between positive and negative masses (four interaction cases)
description: Schematic table of four cases showing pairs of circles marked + or - with arrows indicating motion, labeled "attraction" (case 1), "selfacceleration" (cases 2 and 3), and "repulsion" (case 4). Caption reads "Figure 1. Forces." Above it is a text table, "Table 1. Interactions," listing gravitational field producing mass, test particle mass and resulting motion for negative-mass gravity cases.
